Resource.Name: Admin.Plugins.ExternalAuthenticationMethods.Oidc.Description
Resource.Value:
The identity provider and the client are configured in the application settings file (appsettings), not here: section OidcResourceServer holds the identity provider (Authority), section OidcLogin holds the client of this store (ClientId, ClientSecret, Scopes).

Register this redirect URI at the identity provider for every URL of the store: https://<store-url>/signin-oidc.

Restart the application after changing the settings. Staff accounts connect once with their password; use the multi-factor authentication of the identity provider for them.

The order of the button is set by OidcLogin:DisplayOrder.
